name: Lawyers
overview: Scripture calls those involved in legal judgment to uphold righteousness and impartiality, warning against perverting justice for the poor or showing favoritism to the mighty. True advocacy is portrayed as delivering and defending the vulnerable, speaking truth to protect those facing destruction. Justifying the wicked or condemning the innocent is condemned as an abomination to the Lord, emphasizing that legal professionals must align their work with God’s standards of justice and mercy.
